message: Scaled 1 of 2 feed rates to 80 %; 1 left as the possible lead of a tapping cycle. No machine: profile defaults assumed.

findings.message: F520 is written while CYCLE840 (line 7) repeats after every move. A tapping cycle written as a call can take its thread lead from that feed (the feed is then the spindle speed times the pitch), so it is left as written: scaled, it would cut a different thread. Scale it by hand if the cycle takes its lead from its own arguments.
